items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 22 November 2026 6:00am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds until later.


##Wind)##

East or Southeast 6 or 7, gradually decreasing Southeast 5 or 6 this afternoon, then Southeast 4 or 5 early tonight.


##State of sea)##

Moderate or rough, becoming moderate this afternoon, slight or moderate tonight.


##Weather)##

Fair.


##Visibility)##

Good.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 9°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Strong to gale force winds developing.


##Wind)##

Southeast 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 to west of island in morning, then generally 5 or 6 in afternoon. Further increasing Southeast 6 or 7 early in night.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming moderate, then moderate or rough later.


##Weather)##

Fair, then rain arriving late.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain late.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 7°C and max. air temperature 9°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
